allowed_changes: use frozen daily VIX close series only
latest VIX observation dated <= T-1 signal date and <=7 calendar days stale
hold 100% gold when VIX >30; 100% Nasdaq when VIX <=30; cash only if VIX unavailable
observe state each execution session but trade only when owner changes
fixed annual 50/50 Nasdaq-gold barbell and CNY cash controls
expected_outputs: owner-by-month/state audit, trades, cash, gross and fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After formal results, no VIX threshold, persistence, hysteresis, term-structure, owner, asset, weight, stale tolerance, fee or confirmation-filter rescue is permitted in this lineage.
forbidden_changes: VIX 20/25/35/40 or any other threshold scan
minimum days above/below 30, hysteresis or confirmation
VIX moving average, percentile, z-score, slope or term-structure combo
adding momentum, drawdown, NFCI, credit, Sahm or macro confirmation
changing risk-on/risk-off assets or blending weights
changing stale tolerance, fee/slippage after results
shorting, leverage, financing, gross >100% or negative cash
hypothesis: A VIX close above 30 represents an unusually high option-implied volatility / market-fear state. Using only the completed T-1 VIX close, rotating from Nasdaq to gold while VIX is above 30 and returning to Nasdaq otherwise may reduce the deepest equity panic losses while preserving normal-market growth exposure. The state is observed daily but trades occur only when ownership changes.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
selection_metric: One externally motivated VIX=30 threshold only. No VIX threshold/window/persistence search. Validation, objective and comparison against fixed annual Nasdaq-gold barbell are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.
strategy_lineage: vix-panic-001 / VIX经典恐慌状态001; option-implied panic rotation between Nasdaq and gold
validation_gates: execution-stress evidence deferred and explicitly warned
